title.narrative: Capacity Building of National Human Rights Institutions ¿NHRI.EU ¿ Phase 3

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Action is to enhance the role of NHRIs, the Global Alliance of National Human Rights Institutions (GANHRI), and regional networks ¿ Asia Pacific Forum of National Human Rights Institutions (APF), the Network of African National Human Rights Institutions (NANHRI), La Red de Instituciones Nacionales Para la Promoción de Los Derechos Humanos en el Continente Americano (RINDHCA) and the European Network of National Human Rights Institutions (ENNHRI) ¿ in promoting and protecting human rights of all individuals. This overall objective is linked explicitly to SDG target 16a (Strengthen relevant national institutions, including through international cooperation, for building capacity at all levels, in particular in developing countries, to prevent violence and combat terrorism and crime) and have links with other SDGs ¿ specifically, SDG5 (Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls); SDG10 (Reduce inequality within and among countries); and SDG16 (Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels).


To reach this objective, the project aims to enhance the role of NHRIs and their global and regional networks in promoting and protecting the human rights of all individuals
